basic.name: Discord Strike
basic.description: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165~~0.04~~ damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

basic.name: Telekinesis
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48~~0.04~~ damage to enemies.

basic.name: Lightning Surge
basic.description: Deal 62~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75~~0.04~~ health for each Hero hit.

basic.name: Lightning Surge
basic.description: Deal 62~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75~~0.04~~ health for each Hero hit.

heroic.name: Deadly Charge
heroic.description:
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200~~0.04~~ damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.

Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

heroic.name: Counter-Strike
heroic.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Unleash Deadly Charge
heroic.description:
Unleash Alarak's Deadly Charge.

Issuing a move order while this is channeling will cancel the cast at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

trait.name: Sadism
trait.description:
Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.

Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

activable.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
activable.description:
Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.

Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.

Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

activable.name: Hasty Bargain
activable.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

activable.name: Last Laugh
activable.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

activable.name: Might of the Highlord
activable.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

level1.name: Overwhelming Power
level1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

level1.name: Ruthless Momentum
level1.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

level1.name: Extended Lightning
level1.description:
Reduce Sadism by 10%.

Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.

Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

level4.name: Chaos Reigns
level4.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

level4.name: Negatively Charged
level4.description:
Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.

Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

level4.name: Show of Force
level4.description:
Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61~~0.04~~ damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%. 

Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

level7.name: Dissonance
level7.description: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

level7.name: Hindered Motion
level7.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

level7.name: Applied Force
level7.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

level13.name: Blade of the Highlord
level13.description:
Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

level13.name: Pure Malice
level13.description:
Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.

Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

level16.name: Lethal Onslaught
level16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

level16.name: Lightning Barrage
level16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

level16.name: Mocking Strikes
level16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

level20.name: Wrath of the Highlord
level20.description:
If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds.

If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

level20.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.
